title: Okay, but could be improved
text:
Okay, but could be improved. PROS:
- Large capacity
- Very well built
- Able to handle plety of weight
- Good stain release in wash for minor spills

CONS:
- Hard to open and fill
- Wrinkles excessively when washed for the first time
- Unusually large amount of shrinkage when washed, even in gentle cycle and lowest heat setting

WOULD I BUY IT AGAIN?
I would look for something that is easier to fill instead.
